text: {"lessons":["Selling 20 shares of Stock B at a gain felt satisfying, but one profitable sale does not show that I can predict future prices.","My account fell in the last two periods, so I should keep risk and diversification in view rather than react to losses or try to win them back quickly.","Past price changes have no reliable power to predict the next month; I should make deliberate decisions based on my plan, not frequent checking or short-term moves."]}
